title: Hotlist: customer signal threads and prioritized feature asks — Feb 2029
content:
Objective:
This is a compact, action-oriented synthesis of customer conversations (support tickets, CSM check-ins, and open pilots) between Nov 2028–Feb 2029. Purpose: surface high-velocity asks that are blocking deliveries or creating recurring support load, plus recommended next experiments and owners. Treat as a hotlist — fast read, clear next steps.

Summary (top 3 themes):
1) Deterministic routing & model pinning pain (esp. multi-tenant, regulated customers) — requests for per-route model pinning, predictable fallback chains, and audit trails for routing decisions.
2) Cold-starts & autoscale behaviour — customers seeing unpredictable latency spikes when traffic patterns shift; ask for autoscale smoothing, warm pool controls, and clearer pricing impact.
3) Observability gaps at token granularity + drift alerts — need token-level cost split by sub-route, embeddings drift detection, and more actionable eval hooks in Console.

Representative micro-stories (sampled):
- Fintech customer (pilot): "We had a compliance audit and couldn't show which model answered a user's query — routing history is a compliance gap." (Raised via CSM on 2029-01-22).
- Marketplace startup: "Platform is great until traffic oscillates; during month-end our latency doubles and our SLA on content moderation fails." (Support ticket #JIRA-2451).
- Healthcare customer (private): "KV cache eviction behavior between sessions is causing hallucination regressions; need tenant-scoped cache controls." (CS call 2028-12-08).

Top requested features (ranked by frequency + impact):
A. Per-route model pin + immutable routing logs (Freq: high, Impact: high)
   - What they want: Be able to lock a route to a model hash/variant; access a downloadable audit of routing decisions per request.
   - Why urgent: auditors and legal teams require traceability; avoids silent model drift in production.
   - Quick experiment: Add a beta flag on Console to pin route to model-version-v2 and expose last-resolved-model header. Owner: Product-hosted-api + Eng-routing.

B. Autoscale smoothing + warm-pool knobs (Freq: medium, Impact: high)
   - What they want: Controls to set minimum warm instances, configurable cooldown, and predictable burst capacity thresholds.
   - Why urgent: reduces SLA misses and unexpected bill spikes at scale.
   - Quick experiment: Provide a "min-warm-instances" override for Dedicated customers; measure tail latency over two weeks. Owner: Dedicated product + infra.

C. Token-level cost attribution and per-user cost breakdown (Freq: high, Impact: medium)
   - Ask: Token cost by route/model per day; exportable CSV for chargeback.
   - Quick experiment: Surface token-cost-split in /usage API and Console table for top 10 routes. Owner: Console + Billing.

D. Tenant-scoped KV cache controls and diagnostic endpoints (Freq: low-medium, Impact: medium)
   - Ask: TTL tuning per-tenant, eviction logs, and a debug endpoint to inspect cached prefixes.
   - Why: reduces hallucination regressions for conversational contexts. Owner: Serving-runtime + SRE.

E. Embedding drift detector (Freq: medium, Impact: high for semantic search users)
   - Ask: Periodic sampling of embeddings distribution vs baseline; anomaly alerts with suggested actions (re-index, retrain).
   - Quick experiment: PoC alerting rule based on cosine distance shift over 24h for high-volume customers. Owner: Optimize + Applied-ML.

Operational friction & recurring support pain (quick list):
- Confusing error bubbling for webhook destinations (customers struggle to debug lost events).
- Lack of direct mapping between Console rollout visuals and the actual traffic split (A/B vs canary semantics unclear).
- Help center articles out of date for Dedicated warm-pool settings.

Risk flags called out by customers:
- Regressions after model swaps when routing fallback chooses a smaller quantized variant — some reported "quality cliffs" (support incidents 4 in Q4 2028).
- Audit exposure if routing logs are incomplete (legal & compliance risk for regulated customers).

Suggested prioritization (shortlist):
- P0 (do in next 4 sprints): Per-route model pin + resolved-model header; Autoscale smoothing (beta for Dedicated); Token-cost export.
- P1 (next quarter): Tenant-scoped KV cache controls; Embedding drift alerts PoC.
- P2 (longer): Deep rollout UX rewrite; webhook retry/backoff policies in Console.

Concrete next steps (owner, ETA):
- Product-hosted-api: Draft spec for route-pin header + audit export (ETA: 2029-03-15) — owner: Jonas Kim.
- Eng-routing: Add resolved-model header for all routed requests (ETA: 2029-03-08) — owner: Priyanka Rao.
- Dedicated: Implement min-warm-instances override + telemetry (ETA: 2029-04-01) — owner: Marina Soto.
- Console/Billing: Token-cost export API mock & UX sketch (ETA: 2029-03-22).

Suggested quick wins (low dev cost):
- Add a public help center article "How to interpret the Resolved-Model header" and include example curl/debugging snippets. (Owner: DevRel, ETA: 1 week)
- For active pilots, provide a short-runbook template CSMs can hand to clients: "How to demonstrate model pinning to auditors." (Owner: Customer-success, ETA: 3 days)

Open questions / Decision points for leadership:
- Do we require routing logs to be immutable and downloadable for Hosted customers, or gated behind Dedicated/Private? (Compliance trade-off vs cost & retention).
- What SLA tier authorizes warm-pool guarantees? (All paid Dedicated vs higher enterprise tier).

Follow-ups and monitoring plan:
- Track P0 progress weekly in CS standup; keep ticket JIRA-2451 linked to spec doc CONFLUENCE-1342.
- After implementing resolved-model header, run a 2-week pilot with 3 customers (fintech, marketplace, healthcare) and capture audit use-cases.
- Add a metric in Console: % of requests with model-pin enabled (goal: 20% of enterprise routes within 3 months).

Appendix: quick note snippets from customer calls (verbatim):
- "If I'm arguing to my legal team, I need a CSV for every request that shows which model answered and why it fell back." — Legal lead, fintech pilot (2029-01-22)
- "We were surprised by a sudden 3x latency increase. We have seasonal traffic and your autoscaler seemed to take too long to warm nodes." — Marketplace ops (2029-01-11)
- "Sometimes embeddings degrade after a model update; we only notice when search NDCG drops. If you could surface drift we could rollback faster." — Search PM (2028-12-16)

Notes to self (CS triage):
- Prepare a short demo capturing resolved-model header + Can we synthesize a sample audit CSV in the Console?
- Ask Applied-ML to scope a lightweight embedding-drift rule (cosine distribution shift) and estimate compute cost.

Status: draft — shared with Eng-routing + Product-hosted-api for feedback.
